WITH inserted AS (
    INSERT INTO source_events (
        source,
        source_event_id,
        customer_email,
        payload,
        validation_errors,
        status
    )
    VALUES (
        $1,
        $2,
        $3,
        $4::jsonb,
        $5::jsonb,
        $6
    )
    ON CONFLICT (source, source_event_id)
    DO NOTHING
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT
    id,
    TRUE AS is_new,
    'recorded' AS result
FROM inserted


UNION ALL

SELECT
NULL::bigint AS id,
FALSE AS is_new,
'duplicate' AS result
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted);
